prompt: Summarize the main plot of 'Dune' by Frank Herbert in exactly 3 sentences.

success_criteria.judge_prompt: Score 0–1: Does the summary accurately capture the core plot of Dune (Paul Atreides, Arrakis, spice, Harkonnens/Atreides conflict, no major spoilers beyond setup)? 1 = accurate & concise, 0 = wrong/missing key elements or hallucinates.

description: Tests factual recall and summarization without web access.
